trails.why: The hiking trail starts at Metsanurme village museum and runs along paths and the shore path of the Keila River to Üksnurme Manor.

trails.why: Twisting trails pass scenic lakes, eskers and bog pools, and can be combined into routes of different lengths and difficulty levels.

trails.name: Kurtna hiking trail
trails.why: The density of lakes of different types, variable landscapes, beauty of wetlands and vegetation form an enchanting mosaic to enjoy.

trails.name: Jussi nature trail
trails.why: The nature trail is surrounded with varied nature and landscapes. The Jussi Moor is a unique natural community in Estonia that conditioned by the activities of the Soviet Army's activity and the several forest fires caused by that.

trails.name: Majakivi-Pikanõmme õpperada
trails.why: The trail introduces Majakivi, the third largest erratic boulder in Estonia, old accretion ridges, alternating bog types and forests of the Juminda peninsula.

trails.name: Kotka hiking trail
trails.why: Hiking trail introduces the fen and the transition mire and sandy eskers. Its sights include the high wooded sandy eskers, which developed when Lake Peipus receded, and the mystic bog islands in Rüütli bog.

trails.name: Taevaskodade hiking trail
trails.why: This three-kilometre-long, circular itinerary will take you through picturesque openings and early visions of the forces of nature, as well as the world of legends, memorabilia, and film.

trails.name: Seljamäe õppematkarada
trails.why: The study trail introduces the Seljamägi hill, pine forest, transition mire, Põdraallikad and offers scenic views of the wildlife.

trails.name: Viitna nature study trail
trails.why: The trails introduce the various glacial landforms and lakes of different trophicity between kames.

trails.name: Õrde allikas
trails.why: Many people have visited the Mahtra Manor, but there is nothing much to do - a monument, a quarry, a tiger's nest and a tiger's nest.

trails.name: Riisa õpperada
trails.why: The rice paddy passes through the picturesque grassland and the forests of the Navest River, and you can also see through the pit and the water table.

trails.name: Sagadi-Oandu metsajuttude rada
trails.why: Under the old logs in Sagadi Alley, the villages of the Tepel Field, and the light-colored pine forests, you can read and listen to tales of the forest and stories from places along the trail.

trails.name: Paukjärve loodusrada
trails.why: Nature trail runs on the hills and valleys surrounding Lake Paukjärv. It is surrounded by different types of forest - the moist and dim boreal forest and the pine forest full of light.

trails.name: Luite hiking trail
trails.why: The trail runs in parallel with the dune up to the mouth of the Rannapungerja river, passing through Kauksi campsite on its way.

trails.name: Teringi õpperada
trails.why: The 4.5 km long circular curb is ideal for walking for a person without special travel allowance.

trails.name: Luhasoo õpperada
trails.why: The only protected area in the area, Luhaso, is interesting in that you can see all the stages of the formation of the reef, from lowland to the highlands.

trails.name: Pahkla matkarada
trails.why: The Pahkla missile base has a total of six remarkable landmarks.

trails.name: Uljaste hiking trail
trails.why: The hiking trail takes visitors to Lake Uljaste, the esker, mire and primeval forest. The trail is signposted and runs mostly along eskers.

trails.name: Käsmu loodus- ja kultuurilooline rada
trails.why: The trail introduces the history of the smallest peninsula in Lahemaa National Park, the largest boulder field in Estonia and the rich cultural heritage of the Käsmu village.

trails.name: Karjaoru waterfall
trails.why: The Shepherd's Nest is located in the village of Saka, near Jõhvi, in the county of East Viru.
